newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ASA says to raise S$20 mln in share issue.
newsitem.headline: ASA says to raise S$20 mln in share issue.

text.p: Semiconductor company Advanced Systems Automation Ltd (ASA) said on Friday it aimed to raise Singapore $20 million from the issue of 10.4 million new shares.
ASA said in a statement Kay Hian Pte Ltd had agreed to subscribe or procure subscriptions for 10.4 million new ordinary shares of S$0.10 at a price of S$2.00.
The S$2.00 price tag was 2.4 percent below the S$2.05 last transacted price of ASA shares quoted on the Stock Exchange of Singapore at 5.00 pm on April 30.
The new shares would increase the issued and paid-up share capital of the company to S$11.4 million divided into 114.2 million shares.

ASA said proceeds from the issue would be used to finance expansion, acquire a new subsidiary -- Avalon Technology Pte Ltd -- undertake research and development, create new product lines and for working capital purposes.
In a separate statement, ASA confirmed it had acquired Avalon in a deal which it said would have no material impact on earnings or net tangible assets in the current year.
